purpose: Exploratory post-hoc illustrations after release of all 300 low-H primary positions; no primary outcome selection or re-estimation.
common_ranking: Descending minimum sample-mean advantage over all worlds, all/even/odd estimators, and noncommon alternatives; then strongest inferior-alternative margin; then position ID.
counterexample_ranking: Empty world-best intersection independently in all/even/odd estimators, ranked by pooled sample oracle gap then persistent disjoint world-pair count; descriptive post-selection, not a confidence bound.
immediate_definition: At least one common best root action has zero continuation steps in all 512 saved cells; excludes such positions from the requested nonimmediate list.
opponent_choices: Not inferable from saved row step counts; marked unverified until a separate limited trace.
limits: Finite sampled worlds and fixed continuation policies, supplied full decklists, imperfect history conditioning; no optimal-play claim.
